    @[simp]
    theorem ZFib.External.OperatorAlgebra.CEP.Faithful.defectHeadFiber_reindex {X : Type u} {H : Type v} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H] [DecidableEq X] (E0 : X → CorrEndBimod H H) (x : X) (w : HeadIsnt x) :
    RelWordFiberReduced intTensorFiber E0 ↑((headConsEquiv x).symm w) = intTensorFiber (E0 x) (RelWordFiberReduced intTensorFiber E0 ↑w)

    The cons/tail reindexing turns a non-x tail into the corresponding head-x relative word fiber. With the concrete Boca interior tensor, this fiber is literally CorrTensor (E0 x) of the tail fiber.

    Carrier-level form of defectHeadFiber_reindex: the reindexed head-x fiber is the completed correspondence tensor of the leading factor with the tail fiber.

    noncomputable def ZFib.External.OperatorAlgebra.CEP.Faithful.defectHeadFiberEquiv {X : Type u} {H : Type v} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H] [DecidableEq X] (E0 : X → CorrEndBimod H H) (x : X) (w : HeadIsnt x) :
    CorrTensor (E0 x) (RelWordFiberReduced intTensorFiber E0 ↑w) ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] RelWordFiberCarrier intTensorFiber E0 ↑((headConsEquiv x).symm w)

    Coordinate fiber isometry used in the defect-head block: each distributed summand CorrTensor (E0 x) (tail fiber) is definitionally the reduced-word fiber of the corresponding head-x word under headConsEquiv.symm.

      CorrTensor (E0 x) (lpRelFiber fun (w : HeadIsnt x) => RelWordFiberReduced intTensorFiber E0 ↑w) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] PiLp 2 fun (w : HeadIsnt x) => RelWordFiberCarrier intTensorFiber E0 ↑((headConsEquiv x).symm w)

      Boca DAG brick B9, in the direction currently supplied by corrTensorLpDistribIso: pulling the leading correspondence over the tail l2 block into the reindexed head-x block.

      The codomain is the head-x block indexed by tails via headConsEquiv.symm. A two-sided LinearIsometryEquiv to the unreindexed HeadIs x block is the follow-on once the reverse/surjectivity side of corrTensorLpDistribIso is registered.
